definitions.gloss: company president, CEO, head of a company
definitions.explanation: The highest-ranking executive in a company.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}に{会|あ}いたいです。
examples.english: I want to meet the company president.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{社長|しゃちょう}が{決|き}まった。

notes:
Corporate hierarchy includes:
- {会長|かいちょう} - chairman
- {社長|しゃちょう} - president
- {専務|せんむ} - managing director
- {部長|ぶちょう} - department head
- {課長|かちょう} - section chief
